messages:
katie: heads up — proposal to reshape tenant metrics storage for console dashboards. change includes renaming `route_id` -> `route_key`, adding `tenant_hash` for faster sharding, and collapsing per-route time-series into a single compactized table. want to discuss backfill strategy and dashboard fallback UX.
raj: sounds good. do we have queries that depend on `route_id` somewhere in the console? fyi that name change will break a few legacy dashboard projections.
mike: @katie +1 on the target, but we need a safe dual-write window. can we do a dualwrite from ingest for 2 weeks and run an async backfill for older rows? then flip reads after metrics-team verifies p99s.
elaine: how large is the backfill? rough ballpark tokens/rows? we should estimate IO and replication cost before scheduling.
katie: estimate ~1.2B rows across hot+warm. chunked backfill over 72 hours on dedicated workers looks feasible. plan: dualwrite -> canary reads -> full cutover -> tombstone old cols.
sam: what about console-facing rollouts? if some customers are on dedicated infra, we need config flags per-deployment and a read-adapter for old schema for 30d after cutover.
katie: agree. console plan: show banner in UI during canary, auto-fallback to old endpoints if queries time out. also add a rollout toggle in console for ops to revert quickly.
raj: query adapter: prefer a DB view that maps `route_key` to old `route_id` semantics rather than rewriting every query in app code.
mike: DB view approach is good, but performance could degrade for high-cardinality joins. propose materialized view for last-90d and regular view for cold data.
elaine: on telemetry: we should add events for backfill progress and per-chunk failure counters. sampling at 1% for row-level to avoid blowing up analytics. also add an eval to detect metric regression after cutover.
katie: noted. will add TelemetryEvent(backfill.chunk.complete) and backfill.chunk.error. + alert if retransmit > 5% for any chunk.
raj: permissions/acl: private deployments might not allow our backfill workers. we need a self-serve backfill binary customers can run (or skip backfill and rely on adapter). add that to docs.
sam: can we also include a small migration CLI snippet? e.g.: ```bash
# run backfill chunks
./backfill --start 2023-01-01 --end 2024-12-31 --chunk-size 1000000 --parallel 8
```
katie: perfect. I'll draft the runbook.
deploy-bot: scheduled migration job created: migration/tenant-metric-reshape/2026-04-12T03:00Z (owner: katie). status: queued.
mike: one more thing — quota accounting: compacted table changes unit-of-measure for per-route quotas. need to validate billing events before final cutover; maybe hold a soft-gate that keeps previous billing until reconciliation done.
elaine: agreed. will add billing shadow-write and reconcile job.
katie: OK next steps: i'll put a PR with DDL + dualwrite shim + backfill tool. tag @mike @elaine for perf checks. schedule a canary next Wed. any objections?
raj: none from me. :thumbsup:
mike: go for it. let's keep the window conservative.
sam: thanks — will update the console UX checklist and feature flag docs.
katie: thanks all, will post PR link and runbook when ready.
